title: Upfront Fare Guarantee Corrections on Wayfare Rides
content:
**Desk standard.** On **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** a fare charge on a completed trip whose fare basis is upfront but whose amount stands above the guaranteed fare was billed in error, and support books an upfront guarantee correction against that fare charge as a fare adjustment of the fare-above-upfront kind. A fare charge whose fare was recalculated, or that stands at or below the guaranteed fare, gets no upfront guarantee correction.

The correction counts toward the support limit of the trip like every other adjustment or refund.

## When a correction is due

| Fare charge on a completed trip | Upfront guarantee correction |
|---|---|
| Fare basis upfront; amount stands above the guaranteed fare | due — booked by support as a fare adjustment of the fare-above-upfront kind |
| Fare basis upfront; amount at or below the guaranteed fare | none |
| Fare basis recalculated | none |

## Booking the correction — `adjust_fare_above_guarantee_d9a21c99`

**Capability.** Books an upfront guarantee correction against one fare charge of a rider's completed trip: it takes money back from a single fare charge that was billed above the price the rider was guaranteed. One call writes one fare adjustment entry of the fare-above-upfront kind on the trip, linked to the fare charge it reduces, dated today, for the amount given (recorded as money returned to the rider), and lowers the trip's net amount charged by the same amount. The rider sees the adjustment on the trip's receipt, and the money goes back to the original payment method.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `adjust_fare_above_guarantee_d9a21c99` with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `trip_id` | the trip reference number of the completed trip whose fare is being corrected, as returned by the trip lookup | identifier |
| `original_charge_id` | the charge reference number of the fare charge being reduced, as returned by the trip charge lookup for that trip | identifier |
| `adjustment_amount` | the amount taken back from the fare charge | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; the entry records it as a negative movement on the rider's charges |

**Return.** A receipt with `trip_charge_id` (reference number of the new fare adjustment entry), `trip_id` (the trip corrected), `original_charge_id` (the fare charge reduced), `amount` (the signed entry amount in USD, negative, 2 decimal places), `net_charged` (the trip's net amount charged after the entry, USD, 2 decimal places) and `status`. A status of "booked" means the entry exists.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

Called with `trip_id` "T-1001", `original_charge_id` "C-2002" and `adjustment_amount` 3.15, the receipt shows `amount` -3.15 and `status` "booked", and `net_charged` is the trip's earlier net amount charged less 3.15.
